Name: Auralynn - Farmer Portrait
Author: Nightfable
Description:
[size=3]I loved the idea of having farmer portraits reacting to NPC's. I decided to make my own, using Midjourney and Photoshop.

As you can see in my screenshots, I'm in the middle of revamping [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]Jello's Magnus Rasmodius[/url].

If you guys want, I might upload him too. [/size]

[size=5][u]Installation[/u][/size]

Add file to your Stardew Valley [b][u]mods[/u][/b] folder (make sure you have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits for 1.6 mod[/url]).

[size=5][i]AI-generated images made with Midjourney[/i][/size]
